training_sessions_queue_check.name: training_sessions_queue_check
training_sessions_queue_check.value: jsonb_typeof("training_sessions"."exercise_queue") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("training_sessions"."exercise_queue") <= 100 AND "training_sessions"."queue_position" >= 0 AND (("training_sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL AND jsonb_array_length("training_sessions"."exercise_queue") > 0 AND "training_sessions"."queue_position" < jsonb_array_length("training_sessions"."exercise_queue") AND jsonb_typeof("training_sessions"."exercise_queue" -> "training_sessions"."queue_position") = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(("training_sessions"."exercise_queue" -> "training_sessions"."queue_position") -> 'trainingSetId') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'string' AND jsonb_typeof(("training_sessions"."exercise_queue" -> "training_sessions"."queue_position") -> 'trainingNodeId') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'string' AND jsonb_typeof(("training_sessions"."exercise_queue" -> "training_sessions"."queue_position") -> 'trainingHandId') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'string') OR ("training_sessions"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "training_sessions"."queue_position" <= jsonb_array_length("training_sessions"."exercise_queue")))

training_sessions_completion_consistency.name: training_sessions_completion_consistency_check
training_sessions_completion_consistency.value: ((("training_sessions"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "training_sessions"."completion_reason" IS NULL) OR ("training_sessions"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "training_sessions"."completion_reason" IS NOT NULL)) AND ("training_sessions"."completion_reason" IS DISTINCT FROM 'COMPLETED' OR ("training_sessions"."target_questions" IS NOT NULL AND "training_sessions"."answered_questions" >= "training_sessions"."target_questions")))

training_sessions_summary_only_check.name: training_sessions_summary_only_check
training_sessions_summary_only_check.value: "training_sessions"."answer_details_available" = true OR ("training_sessions"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "training_sessions"."completion_reason" = 'USER_FINISHED' AND "training_sessions"."target_questions" IS NULL AND "training_sessions"."exercise_queue" = '[]'::jsonb AND "training_sessions"."queue_position" = 0)
